ledger.sentence: Its evidence review of studies from 1980 to 2025 found nearly half a million medical encounters at mass gatherings, including more than 22,000 heat-related illnesses.
The guidance includes a heat-risk assessment tool and is intended to complement the WHO's heat-health action plan guidance and existing national plans.
The WHO urges governments, event organisers and partners to build heat risk management into health planning and event operations.
